## ![](images/DATA622-HomeLoanAdvisor-Cover-01.png)

Many borrowers walk into a mortgage hoping for the best. The Home Loan Adviser
is a machine learning tool, trained on real Freddie Mac mortgages, that informs
the borrower where they stand before ever engaging with a lender.

::: {.text-center .blockquote .text-danger}

*Its better to know your risk before your lenders do.*

:::

The interactive simulator produces a risk score in plain English, so users can
examine their "what ifs?" before one of the largest decisions of their lives.
